description.en:
Gives a team a tactic during the match. The story matches call it right after the scripted scene in which the team comes up with a new tactic.
The tactic is looked up in the tactics data by its ID. Its tactic number n is read from that record, and bit n - 1 is set in the team's tactics mask for the current match. Nothing happens if the ID is unknown or n is 32 or more.
Which code reads that mask was not traced; the name and the story context point to the tactic becoming available to the team.
Team that gets the tactic: 0 = the player's team, 1 = the opponent team. Any other value does nothing.
Always null (also when fewer than 2 arguments are given).

examples.case: After the scene where the team finds a new tactic (real usage, from btl0004.nut)
Together with a new Special Move after a scripted goal (real usage, from btl0006.nut)
